evidence: The delivery-time fan-outs are bounded: 26 Design lenses, seven acceptance outcomes, 21 pair rows, fewer than 60 sessions per wave, and eight terminal surfaces. One non-gating growth issue remains: reconciliation is specified as a full scan of immutable bundle history.

findings.issue: terminal_truth.reconcile_delivery scans every immutable bundle and verifies every surface digest on each reconciliation, with no indexed head walk, checkpoint, or bounded repair scope.
findings.why: The work grows linearly with retained terminal bundles, a clock-controlled collection. At 10,000 completed waves and eight surfaces per bundle, one reconciliation can require roughly 80,000 digest checks before completing delivery recovery.
findings.suggestion: Keep full immutable history, but define normal reconciliation as head/predecessor plus missing-or-dirty projections using a content-addressed index or verified checkpoint; reserve an explicit offline audit mode for full-history scans.
